name: Signature Bomb
body:
Your practice with a specific bomb formula has yielded incredible results.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature, discovery class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one bomb discovery which requires a creature to make a saving throw; increase that saving throw by 2.
